summary: Wallowa County lookout on the Wallowa-Whitman National Forest; listed only as 1930s and abandoned, and now gone. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned with no date; no source says what, if anything, remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two listings only (firelookout.com page and the FFLA Oregon list). Two web searches turned up nothing else about this lookout. The story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence stops there. The 1930s date is kept as a decade, not an event, since no year is given. Our dataset marks it 'Not on standing map' (firelookout_com), which fits 'gone'. Nothing found describes the site today.
